page: Amazon Web Services x2iedn.16xlarge is a memory-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features 64 vCPUs powered by dedicated Intel Xeon 8375C processors with an x86_64 architecture, running at 3.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 2048 GB of DDR4 memory operating at 3 GHz, providing 32 GB of RAM per physical core. Local storage is provided via a 1900 GB NVMe SSD instance store volume, and the instance supports a baseline network bandwidth of 50 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates strong multi-core performance, with a stress-ng multi-core CPU score of 61947.26 and a PassMark CPU score of 56826.42. The instance excels in database operations, scoring 26144.88 on PassMark database tests, and shows strong performance in software compilation and image processing. Single-core performance and memory bandwidth benchmarks, such as the 153.34 GB/sec uncached large-block read, fall into the average tier.

Given the high memory-to-vCPU ratio of 32:1 and the inclusion of local NVMe storage, this instance offers high resource density for memory-bound workloads. It is qualitatively cost-efficient for consolidating large-scale databases, running in-memory analytics, and executing memory-intensive enterprise applications. The dedicated CPU allocation and 50 Gbps network bandwidth make it suitable for production database hosting, large-scale data processing, and memory-heavy simulation workloads.
